observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with a notch, displaying the lock screen with time 6:37 and date Tuesday, April 14. The screen has a visible crack on the top right corner. The phone has a gold or light-colored frame.

Photo 1: Back view of the phone showing a triple-camera setup in a square module, with a small white sticker that reads '13pro 1TB'. The phone is silver or light gray. The frame appears to be gold or rose gold.

Photo 2: Front view of the phone with the control center open, showing brightness slider and settings. The same crack is visible on the top right corner of the screen. The screen is active and responsive.
All photos have a watermark 'STRONG & BOLD TELECOMS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

read_from: photo 0 and 2: notch design and triple-camera module consistent with iPhone 13 Pro

claims.evidence: Photo 1 sticker says '13pro' and the design matches iPhone 13 Pro (notch, triple-camera module).
Photo 1 sticker says '1TB', but this cannot be verified from photos alone. No settings screen or storage info shown.
Photo 0 and Photo 2 both show a visible crack on the top right corner of the screen.

risks.risk: The phone may not be genuine or may be a refurbished/replica model.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the phone's settings screen showing 'iPhone 13 Pro' and '1TB' storage, or a shot of the back with the model number engraved (e.g., near the camera module).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-tier or non-genuine model, with reduced value.

risks.risk: The crack may be deeper than visible, affecting touch sensitivity or display functionality.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the crack under different lighting, or a demonstration of touch responsiveness around the crack.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a damaged unit with reduced value, assuming the crack affects usability.

risks.risk: The phone may have water damage or internal issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the phone being powered on, camera functionality, and a diagnostic test (e.g., Apple Diagnostics or third-party tool).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used phone with potential hidden defects, assuming worst-case scenario.

proof_requests: A clear photo or video of the phone's settings screen showing the model and storage capacity.
A close-up video of the screen crack under different lighting to assess depth and impact.
A video showing the phone's camera, charging, and overall functionality.
response.reason: While the phone appears to be an iPhone 13 Pro with a visible screen crack, the 1TB storage claim cannot be verified from the photos. There are also hidden risks such as authenticity, internal damage, and crack severity that require additional proof before pricing can be determined accurately.
